C10 shares the defense-mobilization and control-extension setting but is narrower and less textually aligned.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I am forwarding to you for your information copies of the second Quarterly Report to the President by the Director of Defense Mobilization.","parent_excerpt":"I have received the attached report from the National Advisory Board on Mobilization Policy, which I am forwarding for the information of the Congress.","explanation":"Both open by forwarding a defense-mobilization report for legislative information, providing a distinctive shared framing device."},{"child_excerpt":"Everything that Mr. Wilson says in this report emphasizes the tremendous importance of obtaining good, strong control legislation","parent_excerpt":"I recommend most strongly that the defense production bills be strengthened by the Congress","explanation":"Each uses the transmitted report as the basis for demanding strengthened defense-production legislation."},{"child_excerpt":"It is a matter of great urgency that the Congress complete action on this new bill well before July 31.","parent_excerpt":"We do need rapid action by the Congress, and legislation of at least a year's duration","explanation":"The operative request in both letters combines prompt congressional action with legislation durable enough to sustain mobilization."},{"child_excerpt":"Otherwise, the consumers in this country may be plundered by renewed inflation and our whole mobilization program threatened with disaster.","parent_excerpt":"These provisions take the easy way--to relax controls and hope for the best--which is extremely dangerous... A relaxed, soft attitude is an invitation to disaster.","explanation":"Both conclude the legislative appeal with materially similar warnings that weak or relaxed controls invite inflation and disaster for the mobilization effort."}]}
